mapper.update: INSERT INTO finance (merge_key, accounting_standards, fiscal_year_cover_page) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{accountingStandards}, #{fiscalYearCoverPage}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO company_finance (company_id, finance_id, inserted_at, updated_at, deleted, sync_id) SELECT c.company_id, f.finance_id, now(), now(), false, #{syncId}::uuid FROM company c JOIN finance f ON f.merge_key = #{dto.mergeKey} WHERE c.corporate_number = #{dto.corporateNumber} ON CONFLICT (company_id, finance_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now(), sync_id = EXCLUDED.sync_id WHERE company_finance.deleted IS DISTINCT FROM false OR company_finance.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.sync_id
UPDATE company_finance cf SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE cf.deleted = false AND cf.company_id = ( SELECT c.company_id FROM company c WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} )

UPDATE company_finance cf SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE cf.deleted = false AND cf.company_id = ( SELECT c.company_id FROM company c WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} ) AND cf.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{syncId}::uuid
